ebitda.title: Reconcile net income to a 28% margin
ebitda.inputs: net_income: 80000; interest: 10000; income_tax: 20000; depreciation: 20000; amortization: 10000; revenue: 500000

ebitda.title: Include nonoperating income in the operating bridge
steps: Operating income 105,000 plus other nonoperating income 5,000 gives EBIT 110,000.
Add 30,000 D&A to recover the same 140,000 EBITDA. Interest and income tax are not added again.

ebitda.title: Preserve a loss and a tax benefit
ebitda.inputs: net_income: -50000; interest: 5000; income_tax: -10000; depreciation: 10000; amortization: 0; revenue: 200000
steps: Start with a loss of 50,000. Add interest expense 5,000, subtract the 10,000 income-tax benefit, then add 10,000 depreciation.
EBITDA is −45,000; margin on 200,000 revenue is −22.5%.

steps: The advance stays 8,000, but final settlement falls to 1,550.

invoice-factoring.title: Fees exceed the reserve
invoice-factoring.inputs: invoice: 10000; advance_rate: 99; fee_rate: 2; interval: 30; days: 30; billing: Prorated periods; fee_base: Invoice face value; other_fees: 0
steps: A 99% advance pays 9,900 today and leaves a reserve of 100.
The 30-day fee is 200. Settlement = 100 − 200 = −100: another 100 is owed.
invoice-factoring.answer: Signed settlement after fees: -100.00 under these assumptions.
